# Picsel

> Picsel builds websites for tradespeople anywhere in the UK, gets them found on Google and in AI search, and keeps them there.

Contact: Ben Miller, 07456 809049, ben@picsel.co.uk
Area served: United Kingdom

Picsel is a new studio. It has built 5 live sites, all listed below, and
makes no claims about client numbers, years in business or awards, because it has
none to make. Anything stated here can be checked against the live sites.

## What the studio does

- Websites for tradespeople and small businesses, anywhere in the UK
- Search work, both Google and AI assistants
- Google Business Profile setup and upkeep
- Custom automation tools for repetitive office work
- One trade per patch on our Growth plan

## Work

- [A Nevitt Construction](https://picsel.co.uk/work/nevitt-construction/): Construction in Hayle, Cornwall. Live site: https://haylebuilders.com/
- [Julie Miller Art](https://picsel.co.uk/work/julie-miller-art/): Artist portfolio in Scottish Borders. Live site: https://juliemillerart.co.uk/
- [Lanora House](https://picsel.co.uk/work/lanora-house/): House clearance in Hayle, Cornwall. Live site: https://www.lanorahouse.com/
- [AJC Removals & Clearances](https://picsel.co.uk/work/ajc-removals/): Removals & clearance in Cornwall. Live site: https://ajcremovals.co.uk/
- [House of Cornwall](https://picsel.co.uk/work/house-of-cornwall/): Antiques & auctions in Hayle, Cornwall. Live site: https://houseofcornwall.live/

## Pages

- [Websites for tradesmen across the UK | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/): We build fast, honest websites for tradespeople anywhere in the UK, get you found on Google and in AI search, and keep you there. Live in days, not months.
- [Work: websites built for trades and small firms](https://picsel.co.uk/work/): The five sites Picsel has built for tradespeople and small businesses. Every one links out to the live site, so you can judge it the way a customer would.
- [A Nevitt Construction | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/work/nevitt-construction/): A site for a family-run building contractor in Hayle, built with SEO, covering everything from single-storey extensions to full design-and-build new homes.
- [Julie Miller Art | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/work/julie-miller-art/): A portfolio for an illustrator working in mixed media in the Scottish Borders, built four hundred miles from Picsel, where the landscape drives the work.
- [Lanora House | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/work/lanora-house/): A licensed house clearance and cleaning firm working across Cornwall and the South West, with the SEO work included to bring enquiries in. Built by Picsel.
- [AJC Removals & Clearances | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/work/ajc-removals/): A removals and clearance company covering Cornwall, Devon and beyond, where the quote request takes seconds, not a long form to fill in. Built by Picsel.
- [House of Cornwall | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/work/house-of-cornwall/): Live clearance auctions broadcast from Hayle every week, selling antiques, retro pieces and curiosities from house clearances, with the next sale up front.
- [Website and search services for tradespeople](https://picsel.co.uk/services/): Four things we do: websites for tradespeople, Google Business Profiles, the monthly search and AI work, and custom tools for the paperwork you repeat.
- [Websites for tradespeople, live within a week](https://picsel.co.uk/services/websites-for-tradespeople/): A five page website built around your trade, live within a week, with hosting, the security certificate and your Google Business Profile set up too.
- [Google Business Profile setup and management](https://picsel.co.uk/services/google-business-profile/): We claim, verify and fill in your Google Business Profile: categories, services, photos and reviews. A one off job, or set up at launch with any website.
- [Search and AI visibility for tradespeople](https://picsel.co.uk/services/search-and-ai-visibility/): Monthly work to get you found on Google and named by AI assistants. It is the Growth plan, and your build fee comes back if it misses five enquiries.
- [Custom tools for trades: quotes, jobs and photos](https://picsel.co.uk/services/custom-tools/): Custom software built around how your business already works: quotes, job records, photos and stock. Built outright, or built and run for you monthly.
- [Guides for tradespeople | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/): Plain answers to five questions tradespeople actually ask about websites, Google Business Profiles, reviews and what any of it should cost. No sales pitch.
- [What a tradesman's website needs | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/what-a-trades-website-needs/): Your phone number on every page, the jobs you do in the words customers use, the towns you cover, photos of your own work and a few reviews, little else.
- [Why your Google Business Profile is not showing](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/google-business-profile-not-showing/): Usually one of four things: it is not verified, the category is wrong, your details do not match, or an old duplicate is competing with it. All fixable.
- [How much a tradesman's website should cost](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/how-much-a-trades-website-costs/): About £500 to £2,000 as a one off, or £15 to £120 a month on a subscription. What each price actually buys, what to ask before you pay, and what to avoid.
- [What GEO is, and why it matters for trades](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/what-is-geo/): GEO is getting your business quoted by AI assistants when someone asks one to recommend a tradesperson. It is what SEO is to Google, and why it matters.
- [How to get more Google reviews | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/how-to-get-more-google-reviews/): Ask every customer in person on the day the job finishes, and hand them a short review link. What stops it working, and two things that get you penalised.
- [Blog: websites for tradespeople | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/blog/): What I think about websites for tradespeople, what they cost and why they cost it. Opinions rather than answers here. The answers are all in the guides.
- [Why trades websites cost so much | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/blog/why-trades-websites-cost-so-much/): Where the money goes in a three thousand pound website quote, what a trades website actually has to do, and how to tell the two apart. One real number.
- [Contact Picsel: websites for tradespeople](https://picsel.co.uk/contact/): Ring Picsel on 07456 809049, email ben@picsel.co.uk, or send an enquiry. Websites and Google visibility for tradespeople anywhere in the UK, no middleman.
- [About Ben Miller, who runs Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/about/): Ben Miller has built websites for about two years, since his time as creative director at Lanora House. That is why he started Picsel, and how a job runs.
- [What happens to your details | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/privacy/): What Picsel does with your enquiry details: what the form collects, where it goes, how long we keep it, and how to get a copy or ask us to delete them.
